revision.reason: Record the owner's existing-Sentinel extension, seven-part narrative and discovery-first 13-wave contract.
reconciliations: CandidateCue is distinct from admitted ThreatCue; HOLD/DENY are AdmissionDecision outcomes and SUPPRESS/ESCALATE are orthogonal dispositions.
Tenant and mission scope is mandatory across objects and indirect read/write paths.
Commercial evidence has a separate proof boundary; release, rights and epoch roots stay independent.
Cue proofs, completed epoch membership and later receipt links are acyclic detached artifacts.
Source-inspection evidence is preserved unchanged; no runtime or official claim is promoted.
